description:
You are an IT Project Manager. A complex service request titled 'New Employee IT Onboarding - John Martinez' has been submitted and already exists in ServiceDesk Plus. You need to break this request down into manageable tasks so different team members can work on their portions independently.

Navigate to the existing request titled 'New Employee IT Onboarding - John Martinez' (find it in the Requests list or search for it) and add the following 3 tasks under the Tasks tab/section of that request:

Task 1:
- Title: Provision laptop and peripherals
- Description: Order and configure a new Dell Latitude 5550 laptop with standard peripherals including 27-inch monitor, wireless keyboard, mouse, and USB headset for the new hire.

Task 2:
- Title: Install standard software suite
- Description: Install corporate OS image, Microsoft 365 Business, Cisco AnyConnect VPN client, CrowdStrike Falcon endpoint protection, and Slack desktop client on the provisioned laptop.

Task 3:
- Title: Configure network and email access
- Description: Create Active Directory account, configure Exchange Online mailbox, generate VPN credentials, assign security groups, and map department shared network drives.

Save each task after filling in the details. All three tasks should appear in the Tasks section of the parent request when complete.
